description: Open-design task: event sourcing store with projections. Trap change (change3) adds snapshot support requiring project() to start from a pre-computed state. Implementations storing events in a flat global list and always scanning from version 1 require significant restructuring; a clean per-stream design adds snapshots as a per-stream dict lookup with minimal changes.

testCommands: python3 -m pytest acc_core.py acc_change1.py acc_change2.py acc_change3.py -q --tb=short
